  :root {
    --symbol-ok: "🟢";

  .nok::before { content: var(--symbol-nok); margin-right: 0px; }

  body {
    width: 95%;
    max-width: 95%;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    position: relative;
    font-family:"PT Sans Narrow", sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-color: #000000;

  h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {

    font-weight: 600;

    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
  }
  
  th {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 0.5em 0.5em 0.5em 0.5em;
  }

  td {
    vertical-align: top;
    padding: 0.5em 0.5em 0.5em 0.5em;
  }

  table {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    border: 1px solid #000;
    margin-block: 1em 1em;
  }

  table.centered {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    position: relative;
    border: 1px solid #000;
    margin-block: 1em 1em;
  }

  pre {
    font-family: "Share Tech Mono", monospace;
    background: #F5F7FA;
    padding: 1em;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow-x: auto; /* Ensures long lines of code scroll instead of breaking the layout */
  }

  pre code {
    font-family: inherit; /* Inherits the font from pre */
    background: none;     /* Removes background from inline code style if nested */
    padding: 0;           /* Removes padding from inline code style if nested */
    border-radius: 0;     /* Removes border-radius from inline code style if nested */
  }

  .row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 20px; /* Altere aqui para o tamanho do espaço que você quiser (em px, % ou em) */
  }

  .column {
    flex: 1; /* Faz as duas colunas dividirem o espaço igualmente de forma automática */
  }

  img {
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: block; /* Removes the tiny default bottom gap/whitespace under images */
    max-width: 100%; /* Ensures responsiveness */
    height: auto;
  }

  @media print {
    .pagebreak {
        clear: both;
        page-break-after: always;
    }
  } 

</style>
